name: EmoV-DB: The Emotional Voices Database
description: The Emotional Voices Database (EmoV-DB) is an expressive speech corpus recorded to enable emotion transformation in speech synthesis. Containing 6,837 studio audio recordings across 4 English speakers and 1 French speaker expressing five core emotional states: neutral, amusement, anger, sleepiness, and disgust.
